title: thalictrum jacquinianum subsp. saxatile
intro: Thalictrum jacquinianum subsp. saxatile, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species native to Central Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it beneficial for various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its use as an antiseptic and astringent. The bioactive constituents of Thalictrum jacquinianum subsp. saxatile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
